visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with a ponytail wearing a white t-shirt sits at a light-colored wooden table, looking down at a colorful picture book held by an adult's hands. The background is a bright indoor room with a large window showing green trees outside and a white electric fan on the windowsill. (2) Close-up shots of the girl's hands holding a paintbrush dipped in green paint, drawing straight lines on white cards. The adult's hands occasionally guide her or point at the cards. (3) The girl has paint applied to her palm; first yellow, then red, and finally blue. She presses her painted palm onto the white cards to create handprint flower shapes. Facial expressions show focus and concentration, followed by wide-eyed curiosity. (4) The scene shifts to an indoor living area where the girl presents a card to her mother, who is wearing a black shirt. They share a hug and a kiss. (5) The final phase occurs outdoors in a garden area with green grass and stone paths; the girl runs toward an older woman (grandmother) and hands her a card. A bicycle and greenery are visible in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly male voice initiates a conversation about a storybook, followed by a child's soft vocal response. A bright, mid-tempo acoustic guitar track begins. (2) A sharp 'bubble pop' SFX marks a transition to the child and man discussing the 'bubble flower' activity. The child's vocal pitch is high and excited. (3) Rhythmic brush strokes on paper create faint friction sounds. A 'ding' SFX signals the start of the painting phase. (4) Rhythmic counting 'one, two, three' in Chinese occurs as hands are pressed. Each print is accompanied by a 'pop' or 'woosh' sound effect to emphasize the action. (5) High arousal female voices (mother and aunt) express joy with long vowel sounds like 'wow' and 'so cute,' followed by audible kissing sounds. (6) The audio transitions to an outdoor environment with a subtle wind noise floor. The child yells 'Grandma' happily. The video ends with a short melodic jingle over a logo animation.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share a heartwarming family activity where a young child creates handmade Mother's Day cards and presents them to her family members, evoking feelings of warmth and domestic happiness.
